lines.text: Every token launch hands the team its tokens on day one.
lines.caption: Every token launch hands the team its tokens on day one.

lines.text: The roadmap is just a promise.
lines.caption: The roadmap is just a promise.

lines.text: Vesting only measures time. The tokens unlock whether anything was built or not.
lines.caption: Vesting only measures time. The tokens unlock whether anything was built or not.

lines.text: Nobody checks if the promise was kept.
lines.caption: Nobody checks if the promise was kept.

lines.text: With KEPT, a team locks its tokens behind public milestones. A release on GitHub. A live website. A deployed contract. A number on chain.
lines.caption: With KEPT, a team locks its tokens behind public milestones. A release on GitHub. A live website. A deployed contract. A number onchain.

lines.text: Each one becomes a single yes or no question, written by the vault itself.
lines.caption: Each one becomes a single yes or no question, written by the vault itself.

lines.text: At the deadline, the team asks the I M D oracle. A panel of nine agents checks the milestone, and seven must agree.
lines.caption: At the deadline, the team asks the IMD oracle. A panel of 9 agents checks the milestone, and 7 must agree.

lines.text: The verdict is signed, and the vault verifies it on chain.
lines.caption: The verdict is signed, and the vault verifies it onchain.

lines.text: Kept, and that share of the tokens goes to the team.
lines.caption: Kept, and that share of the tokens goes to the team.

lines.text: Not proven in time, and it burns.
lines.caption: Not proven in time, and it burns.

lines.text: This is live on Robinhood Chain. KEPT locked three hundred million of its own tokens behind its roadmap.
lines.caption: This is live on Robinhood Chain. KEPT locked 300 million of its own tokens behind its roadmap.

lines.text: The swarm has confirmed two promises so far. Eight of nine agents agreed on the first, seven of nine on the second. One hundred and fifty million KEPT, released.
lines.caption: The swarm has confirmed two promises so far. 8 of 9 agents agreed on the first, 7 of 9 on the second. 150 million KEPT, released.

lines.text: Every trade in the KEPT pool pays one percent of its I M D into a fund that refunds the check for teams who keep their word.
lines.caption: Every trade in the KEPT pool pays 1% of its IMD into a fund that refunds the check for teams who keep their word.

lines.text: Two hundred and twenty one tests. Three contracts, launched and audited through I M D.
lines.caption: 221 tests. Three contracts, launched and audited through IMD.
